preprint_policy.value: Nature Portfolio journals encourage posting of preprints on preprint servers, authors' or institutional websites, and community preprint servers. Preprints may be posted at any time during the peer review process and will not be considered prior publication. Authors must disclose preprint details (DOI, licensing terms) upon submission. Preprints can be cited in the reference list of articles under consideration.
preprint_policy.notes: Authors should update the preprint record with a publication reference once the article is published. Media coverage of preprints should be handled responsibly, noting that the findings are provisional.

remarks: No specific article types or submission guidelines are provided on this page. The focus is on preprint and conference proceedings policies.
